test_title: PYST 30: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

A. what to tell you and how to say it

B. and there is darkness everywhere

C. and I do not quite know

D. the light has gone out of our lives
solution:
The correct answer is: **DBCA**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Part D**: This part sets the sombre tone of the sentence, conveying a sense of loss or despair.
 
• **Part B**: This part builds upon the previous statement, emphasizing the bleakness of the situation by using the metaphor of darkness.
 
• **Part C**: This part introduces a personal reflection, expressing uncertainty or a lack of understanding about the current circumstances.
 
• **Part A**: This part concludes the sentence by expressing difficulty in finding the right words or conveying the emotions associated with the loss. It provides insight into the speaker's struggle to communicate the depth of their feelings.
 
• So, when arranged in the sequence **DBCA**, the parts form a coherent and meaningful sentence, capturing a sense of sorrow, uncertainty, and difficulty in articulating emotions.

Therefore, **option 2** is the correct answer.
